title: dev-memory-supersession-smoke fails on main because project row 34e97f9 still carries retired product names
description: packages/main/src/tasks/dev-memory-supersession-smoke.ts lists projectCurrentIds [34e97f9, 99aa6c7, ee3aef3, 148297b, 7ffe281] and asserts each row guidance matches /Proof-or-Stop|ProofOrStop/ with proofbound + proof-or-stop + supersedes- tags. Row 34e97f9 in .proof-or-stop/dev-memory/experience.jsonl (unchanged since merge e07d27d450) still says Proofbound/Lattice, so node packages/main/dist/tasks/dev-memory-supersession-smoke.js fails with AssertionError: 34e97f9 should use current product names on the unmodified main dist. The smoke is not registered in proof-or-stop.config.json (npm script only), so proof-or-stop validate stays green; it was found by B-c86f CHK-001 verification on 2026-09-02. Either supersede/rewrite the row through dev_memory_capture with a supersedes- tag or narrow the smoke expectation; do not hand-edit the record silently.
